The plate spans about 400 px in the image, which I take as roughly 26 cm. That gives about 15 px per cm. The egg pile is about 200 px wide, or roughly 13 cm, and about 130 px tall, or roughly 8 cm. That is a footprint of around 80 cm² at a height of about 2 cm, so roughly 150 cm³. Scrambled egg is loose and airy, so I estimate about 0.7 g/cm³, which comes to roughly 110 g. The curds are yellow and fluffy, so I'm treating them as scrambled eggs at 150 kcal/100 g.
